name: KinFlo client starter content pack manifest

providerBoundary.notes: This manifest defines reusable starter content packs for client website onboarding. It does not create pages, write content blocks, publish content, write leads, send campaigns, call providers, import generated API, or execute hosted activation.

blockedUntil: Hosted Convex deployment and generated API review are approved.
Selected starter template and launch blueprint are reviewed.
Content provenance and source-safe copy review are complete.
Read-only hosted smokes pass for starter packs and public preview resolver.
Mutation smoke order, cleanup, and rollback owner are approved before content seeding.

contentPacks.persona: parent, volunteer, donor, and community partner
handoffNotes: Keep original Julie Family source provenance visible before replacing fixture copy.
Confirm family intake routing before publishing public forms.
Review donor and volunteer paths separately so audiences do not compete.

contentPacks.persona: service client evaluating fit and proof
handoffNotes: Proof and process clarity must be reviewed before intake goes live.
Services copy should stay operational and specific, not generic consulting language.
The tenant admin invite remains gated until role scope is approved.

contentPacks.persona: warm campaign lead from email, SMS, referral, or event traffic
handoffNotes: Campaign copy cannot move to provider send until consent is approved.
Lead routing must be reviewed before public forms write to CRM.
AI copy publish and campaign send remain blocked until provider smokes pass.
